data.name: cuRobo
data.description: CUDA-accelerated motion generation library that solves collision-free inverse kinematics and trajectory optimization in parallel on the GPU for robot manipulators.

metadata.Name: cuRobo
metadata.Description: CUDA-accelerated motion generation library that solves collision-free inverse kinematics and trajectory optimization in parallel on the GPU for robot manipulators.
metadata.Citation: Sundaralingam et al., cuRobo: Parallelized Collision-Free Robot Motion Generation, ICRA 2023

data.name: VAMP
data.description: Vector-accelerated motion planning that packs collision checks into SIMD lanes so sampling-based planners solve manipulator queries in under a millisecond.

metadata.Name: VAMP
metadata.Description: Vector-accelerated motion planning that packs collision checks into SIMD lanes so sampling-based planners solve manipulator queries in under a millisecond.
metadata.Citation: Thomason et al., Motions in Microseconds via Vectorized Sampling-Based Planning, ICRA 2024

data.name: RAPTOR
data.description: Reachability-aware trajectory optimization that certifies joint and obstacle constraints over a continuous trajectory rather than at sampled waypoints.

metadata.Name: RAPTOR
metadata.Description: Reachability-aware trajectory optimization that certifies joint and obstacle constraints over a continuous trajectory rather than at sampled waypoints.
metadata.Citation: Zhang et al., RAPTOR: Rapid Aligned Planning of Trajectories for Online Robots, 2024

data.name: CRISP
data.description: Contact-rich interaction planner that reasons over simultaneous contact mode sequences and continuous motion for in-hand and extrinsic manipulation.
